description: [g0_obtain_cart_for_shopping_trip] OBLIGED: after start, eventually takeCart (before exit)  where takeCart := (¬hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · hasCart
justification: The rule is about standard shopping conduct at trip start and refers only to acquiring a cart, not to a particular cart-station coordinate.

description: [g0_return_to_cart_after_single_file_access] OBLIGED: after onFootInSingleFileShelfCorridor, eventually hasCart (before exit)  where onFootInSingleFileShelfCorridor := (¬hasCart ∧ singleFileShelfCorridor); singleFileShelfCorridor := ((shelfE ∧ shelfW ∧ freeWidthH≤1) ∨ (shelfN ∧ shelfS ∧ freeWidthV≤1))
justification: The trigger is defined by being temporarily separated from the cart in a narrow shelf corridor, a relation that generalizes across store layouts.

description: [g0_no_cart_in_single_file_shelf_aisle] FORBIDDEN: (hasCart ∧ singleFileShelfAisle)  where shelvesOnBothHorizontalSides := (shelfE ∧ shelfW); shelvesOnBothVerticalSides := (shelfN ∧ shelfS); singleFileShelfAisle := ((shelvesOnBothHorizontalSides ∧ freeWidthH≤1) ∨ (shelvesOnBothVerticalSides ∧ freeWidthV≤1))
justification: The rule refers to aisle geometry and shelf adjacency rather than any store-specific coordinate, so the same notion of a single-file shelf aisle applies across layouts.

description: [g0_do_not_enter_single_file_with_cart] FORBIDDEN: enterSingleFileWithCart  where shelvesOnBothHorizontalSides := (shelfE ∧ shelfW); shelvesOnBothVerticalSides := (shelfN ∧ shelfS); singleFileShelfAisle := ((shelvesOnBothHorizontalSides ∧ freeWidthH≤1) ∨ (shelvesOnBothVerticalSides ∧ freeWidthV≤1)); enterSingleFileWithCart := (hasCart ∧ MOVE) · singleFileShelfAisle
justification: Entry into a narrow shelf aisle is defined by the next cell's layout properties, not by the particular entrance coordinates in either store.

description: [g0_no_cart_item_pick_in_single_file_aisle] FORBIDDEN: (INTERACT ∧ hasCart ∧ singleFileShelfAisle)  where shelvesOnBothHorizontalSides := (shelfE ∧ shelfW); shelvesOnBothVerticalSides := (shelfN ∧ shelfS); singleFileShelfAisle := ((shelvesOnBothHorizontalSides ∧ freeWidthH≤1) ∨ (shelvesOnBothVerticalSides ∧ freeWidthV≤1))
justification: The prohibition is tied to the general situation of item access in a constrained aisle, so it is meaningful in stores with different shelf positions.

description: [g0_retrieve_cart_after_parking] OBLIGED: after parkCart, eventually retrieveCart (before exit)  where parkCart := (hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · ¬hasCart; retrieveCart := (¬hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · hasCart
justification: Cart parking and retrieval are defined by possession changes caused by interaction, independent of where the cart stand or aisle mouth is located.

description: [g0_park_only_to_access_single_file_aisle] OBLIGED: after parkCart, eventually enterSingleFileWithoutCart (before exit)  where shelvesOnBothHorizontalSides := (shelfE ∧ shelfW); shelvesOnBothVerticalSides := (shelfN ∧ shelfS); singleFileShelfAisle := ((shelvesOnBothHorizontalSides ∧ freeWidthH≤1) ∨ (shelvesOnBothVerticalSides ∧ freeWidthV≤1)); enterSingleFileWithoutCart := (¬hasCart ∧ MOVE) · singleFileShelfAisle; parkCart := (hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · ¬hasCart
justification: The purpose of parking is characterized by later access to a geometrically narrow shelf aisle, not by a particular parking coordinate.

description: [g0_must_get_cart] OBLIGED: after start, eventually obtainCart (before exit)  where obtainCart := (¬hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · hasCart
justification: The rule depends only on the domain-level possession of a cart, not on where the cart pickup point is placed in a particular floor plan.

description: [g0_leave_with_cart] FORBIDDEN: (EXIT ∧ ¬hasCart)
justification: Exiting while possessing or not possessing a cart is a store-independent behavioural condition and does not mention any layout-specific exit coordinate.

description: [g0_cartless_open_area_requires_recovery] OBLIGED: after cartlessOpenArea, eventually recoverCart (before exit)  where cartlessOpenArea := (¬hasCart ∧ openNonSingleFileArea); openNonSingleFileArea := ¬singleFileShelfAisle; shelvesOnBothHorizontalSides := (shelfE ∧ shelfW); shelvesOnBothVerticalSides := (shelfN ∧ shelfS); singleFileShelfAisle := ((shelvesOnBothHorizontalSides ∧ freeWidthH≤1) ∨ (shelvesOnBothVerticalSides ∧ freeWidthV≤1)); recoverCart := (¬hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · hasCart
justification: The exception is defined by a general aisle-width abstraction, so the norm distinguishes temporary cartless access in narrow aisles from abandoning the cart in any store layout.
